channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Parliament Budget Session 2026 highlights: PM Modi hails India-EU free trade for ambitious, confident youth; Viksit Bharat 2047 vision
item.description: PM Modi on Thursday addressed the media ahead of the Budget Session, saying the India-EU trade deal reflects the spirit of an ambitious India. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman tabled the Economic Survey soon after, offering a comprehensive assessment of the economy ahead of the Budget.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty extend gains for 3rd day as economic survey boosts investor sentiment
item.description: At the close of trade, the Nifty index rose 0.3 per cent, or 76.15 points, to settle at 25,418.90. The Sensex also gained 0.27 per cent, adding 221.6 points to end at 82,566.37.

item.title: Mana Shankara Varaprasad Garu and Anaganaga Oka Raju turn blockbusters overseas
item.description: Mana Shankara Varaprasad Garu and Anaganaga Oka Raju have collected $4.5 million and $1.75 million at the overseas box office and emerged as the blockbuster successes in the international market.

item.title: FIR filed against Ranveer Singh for mimicking Kantara Daiva, hurting religious sentiments
item.description: FIR has been filed against Ranveer Singh in Bengaluru ahead of the Netflix OTT release of his new film, Dhurandhar. The case relates to his on-stage mimicry of a Daiva ritual from Kantara during the closing ceremony of IFFI Goa in November 2025. At the time, he had issued an apology, and the controversy had subsided.

item.title: Economic Survey 25-26: India boosts school enrolment, higher education; MSMEs drive growth, exports
item.description: The Economic Survey 2025-26 highlighted India's progress in education and MSME growth. School enrolment and higher education institutions have increased significantly, aided by the Right to Education Act, NEP 2020, and improved infrastructure and teacher capacity.

item.title: Adani Power's Q3 continuing profit before tax rises 5.3 pc to Rs 2,800 crore
item.description: The company's PBT stood at Rs 2,800 crore in Q3 FY26 compared to Rs 2,659 crore in the same period last financial year, supported mainly by lower finance costs and stable operating performance, according to its stock exchange filing.

item.title: Amazon announces to lay off 16,000 employees globally
item.description: Most US-based employees affected will be given 90 days to seek internal roles, while those who do not transition will receive severance pay, outplacement support, and health benefits, subject to local regulations. Despite the layoffs, Amazon said it will continue hiring and investing in strategic areas critical to its long-term growth.

item.title: Did these Instagram astrologers predict Ajit Pawar's plane crash? Appeal to cancel flights goes viral
item.description: As Maharashtra mourns the untimely death of Deputy Chief Minister Ajit Pawar, social media has been flooded with posts by self-proclaimed astrologers claiming they had predicted the plane crash and warning people against air travel.

item.title: Wife arrested after 112 days in J&K's brutal Kathua murder case
item.description: Kathua Police in J&K have solved the blind murder of Bittu Ram, whose mutilated body was found in a nullah in Billawar in October last year, by arresting his wife, Simro Devi. During the investigation, police zeroed in on the victim's spouse, who allegedly confessed to killing her husband following frequent marital disputes arising out of an extramarital relationship.

item.title: Jana Nayagan makers withdrawing case against CBFC amid verdict delay; producer takes different route
item.description: The producer of Jana Nayagan has decided to withdraw the case against the CBFC at the next hearing before the single judge and approach the Revising Committee.
